review: Reviewed magnetic-globe changes, ROB browser source, renderer/presentation lifecycle, exact-ID replay/export controls and focused tests. Existing illustration, observation, catalog, modeled-field and approximate-registration labels remain distinct.

Earth-facing display textures validate dimensions, byte count and normalized samples before using image WCS and observer geometry. Playback texture cache keys include archive, frame and display identity; source callers must supply replay-verified archives. Same-name GONG candidate overlays are explicitly not proof of ROB solver input or calibrated field-line registration.

ROB source selection separates public index/model inspection, explicit owner retention and exact retained reopening. Reproduced five identity failures: another-owner list/receipt and changed source hash, catalog or model time. Reopen now checks the selected record and returned snapshot together.

Reproduced two recovery failures with an unresolved read: changing account/date left controls disabled. Context changes now retire the request reference immediately and restore controls. A later old finalizer cannot clear a newer request.

Reproduced a parent/child integration failure: a globe control change recreated the ROB snapshot callback and aborted the browser request. The stable callback keeps unrelated display changes separate from actual request cancellation.

The previously repaired presentation fixtures now model the import-pending endpoint and actual cached identity changes. They test exact retained bundle acknowledgement, renderer-unavailable rejection, human view changes and account changes, with a mocked renderer rather than actual pixels.

Globe source now allows signed-in owner-retained inspection instead of a developer-only client check, while retaining expected profile/exact source IDs, replay verification and no-scientific-admission flags. Native save receipts are bounded, and browser exports remain explicitly download requests.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal; no installation, public push, native export, live acquisition or scientific verification claim. R380 does not contain these new fixes.

Globe tests use unavailable WebGL or a mock canvas. They exercise local replay and presentation receipts, not GPU texture orientation, actual scene geometry, camera motion or a native installed screenshot.

Shared WCS/registration, PFSS, hash/replay and scene operators remain canonical dependencies, listed as omitted from this web segment. Their mathematical and physical validation is not established by these UI checks.
The real local GONG/PFSS/HMI bundle test replays existing retained bytes; that fixture is separately hashed and not exported. Residual labels are diagnostic, not a scientific admission.

ROB parent-map live acquisition/retention, native JSON save, actual source refresh/revocation and late local file-import account changes remain separate installed/provider qualification. No claim that the entire feature matrix is passed.
Five inherited intentional support-contact matches remain in final owner publication review.
